artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: THE LIMB. Adds invocation_alignment_check(), wired into main() beside the surprises limb so it runs on EVERY instance and prints its denominator whether or not anything diverged. Per acceptance row it compares the instance's recorded `invocation` against the same-id criterion's <invocation> in the GOVERNING task order. Normalisation is exactly two operations, as the cell specifies: declared placeholder expansion and whitespace at the ends -- a changed flag, path, query parameter or quoted argument is a divergence. A placeholder expands to `\S+` (cannot cross whitespace, so an expansion can never swallow an added argument) and a REPEATED placeholder is a backreference (<WS> twice in one command cannot expand to two different workspaces). Helpers: _to_invocations() (which must not let the self-closing <criterion .../> form swallow the next criterion's invocation -- measured on TO-FE-s-15, where the naive regex attributed F15-AC13's invocation to F15-AC12), _declared_placeholders() (None = undeclared = ANNOUNCE; an empty/NONE declaration = ENFORCE expanding nothing), _invocation_pattern(). Also adds 6 self-test arms M-R (12 -> 18) and documents the limb in the module docstring, which is what makes it discoverable from --self-test. NOT DEPLOYED ANYWHERE: this is a repo-local gate; there is no deploy plane.

THE BATTERY, 17 arms, rc=0, new file. Four seeded divergences (changed flag, changed path, added query parameter, changed quoted argument), each shaped like a REAL round-2 ui-smoke invocation because a fixture that cannot represent the failure cannot score it; three substitution-only pairs; a three-arm ANTI-BRICK control proving the tolerance comes from the declaration; and a seven-arm regression over the REAL committed round-2 instances run through the checker's OWN CLI (a different instrument from the function calls the other arms use). Prints ROUND-2 STRICT DIVERGENCE CENSUS immediately beneath the 7-of-7 line so the green cannot be quoted as 'the corpus is aligned'.

Four rows appended, none edited after landing: W3-S13 (the cell's premise that round 2 is honestly aligned is false, both strings for both divergent rows), W3-S14 (318 of 874 comparable rows diverge estate-wide; why ENFORCE is opt-in; ARMED with disarm_owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~F), W3-S15 (correction to this order's own preflight: --help returns rc=2, not rc=0), W3-S16 (disclosure of the one element added to this order's own file). Gate output at the commit: '4 new row(s) of 61 total checked (57 pre-existing, NOT re-graded)', 'OK: 1 file(s), all new rows carry their step-7/step-10 fields.'

ONE element added inside the order's own granted surface, disclosed as row W3-S16: <placeholders>WS</placeholders>, which declares IN THE FILE the substitution the SPAWN PROMPT declared. It changes no criterion id, no invocation, no expectation and no <expected_criteria>. Its effect is that THIS instance is the first in the estate graded on the ENFORCE branch -- every recorded invocation above was DERIVED from the order's text with only <WS> substituted, and the string recorded is the string that was run. Plus the <status> flip to complete.
